cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery couldn't sell your cake, but those roses show you're finally using the piping lesson I gave you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They called it inedible. I thought I had a talent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You do. Remember when I taught you display cakes? You've made one sturdy enough for a window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ring them and offer it for the window. Will you explain that part?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me ring first. You're still learning how to present your work; I'll make sure they understand the roses before they mention the sponge.

reason: Link the protective reinterpretation to specific claimed cake teaching; B practical follow-through makes A intercept the bakery explanation to preserve confidence.
